title: Can apps teach you a language?
speaker: BBC Learning English

keywords.def: suggested or understood without being directly stated
experience of being completely surrounded by something
most important conclusion or discovery from a piece of research
one specific individual thing or person

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听 BBC Learning English 的 6 Minute English。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Pippa. Apps like Duolingo, Babbel and Busuu all aim to help you learn a language, but do they really help?
sentences.zh: 我是 Neil。我是 Pippa。像 Duolingo、Babbel 和 Busuu 这样的应用都旨在帮你学习一门语言，但它们真的有用吗？

sentences.en: We'll be trying to answer that question in today's episode of 6 Minute English, and as usual we'll be learning some useful new vocabulary too.
sentences.zh: 在今天的 6 Minute English 节目中，我们将尝试回答这个问题，和往常一样，我们也会学习一些实用的新词汇。

sentences.en: Yes, and don't forget to head to our website for a transcript of this episode and a free worksheet to test what you've learnt.
sentences.zh: 是的，别忘了访问我们的网站获取本期节目的文稿以及用于测试你所学内容的免费练习册。

sentences.en: It's all at bbclearningenglish.com. OK. Neil, let's start with a quiz question.
sentences.zh: 网址是 bbclearningenglish.com。好的。Neil，我们先来一个问答题。

sentences.en: Which of these is not a language you can learn using Duolingo?
sentences.zh: 以下哪种语言不是你可以通过 Duolingo 学习的？

sentences.en: Is it: a) Latin, b) Klingon, or c) Elvish?
sentences.zh: 是：a) 拉丁语，b) 克林贡语，还是 c) 精灵语？

sentences.en: I'm going to say c) Elvish. Well, we'll find out at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 我猜是 c) 精灵语。好吧，我们会在节目结束时揭晓答案。

sentences.en: Now, people might be familiar with the app Duolingo.
sentences.zh: 现在，人们可能对 Duolingo 这款应用很熟悉。

sentences.en: And then there are other apps which say they can help you learn a language quickly – Bussuu and Babbel, for example.
sentences.zh: 还有其他一些应用宣称能帮你快速学习一门语言——比如 Busuu 和 Babbel。

sentences.en: And listeners might be familiar with how they tend to work.
sentences.zh: 听众们可能对它们的工作方式比较熟悉。

sentences.en: You get short lessons which test you on a repeated set of words.
sentences.zh: 你会得到简短的课程，通过重复的一组单词来对你进行测试。

sentences.en: Pippa Right. And many of these apps say they focus on teaching language for situations and implicit learning, rather than directly teaching language rules such as grammar.
sentences.zh: Pippa 对的。许多这类应用表示，它们专注于针对具体场景的语言教学和内隐学习，而不是直接教语法等语言规则。

sentences.en: If something is implicit, it's suggested but not communicated directly.
sentences.zh: 如果某事是内隐的，它是被暗示的，而不是直接传达的。

sentences.en: Yes. So, if you think about how children learn to speak their first language, it's mostly implicit – they don't have lessons.
sentences.zh: 是的。所以，如果你想想儿童是如何学会说他们的第一门语言的，那主要就是内隐的——他们不上课。

sentences.en: But can this work for adults? BBC Radio 4 programme Sliced Bread has been investigating the evidence behind language learning apps.
sentences.zh: 但这对外成年人有用吗？BBC Radio 4 的节目 Sliced Bread 一直在调查语言学习应用背后的证据。

sentences.en: Presenter Greg Foot spoke to language learning expert Professor Elizabeth Wonnacott, or Liz, about implicit learning.
sentences.zh: 节目主持人 Greg Foot 就内隐学习采访了语言学习专家 Elizabeth Wonnacott 教授（或称 Liz）。

sentences.en: There is a very big difference between being a child who gets constantly exposed to this world of language, compared with trying to learn a language a few hours a week.
sentences.zh: 作为一个不断接触这个语言世界的孩子，与试图每周花几个小时学习语言相比，这两者之间有非常大的区别。

sentences.en: There is quite a bit of evidence that some explicit teaching of, for example, grammar and vocabulary is helpful.
sentences.zh: 有相当多的证据表明，进行一些显性的教学，例如语法和词汇教学，是有帮助的。

sentences.en: Got you. So, it would be helpful to try to mimic what children do, which is full immersion, but realistically you're not going to get to those levels.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。所以，试着模仿孩子们的做法（即完全沉浸式学习）会有所帮助，但现实中你达不到那种程度。

sentences.en: Liz says that while children learn their first language implicitly by being constantly surrounded by the language, adults are often learning for only a few hours a week.
sentences.zh: Liz 表示，虽然孩子们通过不断被语言包围来内隐地学习他们的第一门语言，但成年人通常每周只学习几个小时。

sentences.en: Yes. So, for adults trying to learn a new language, research has shown that some explicit teaching is helpful.
sentences.zh: 是的。因此，对于试图学习新语言的成年人来说，研究表明一些显性教学是有帮助的。

sentences.en: Explicit is the opposite of implicit. So, for example, explicit grammar teaching would be somebody explaining a grammar rule to you.
sentences.zh: 显性与内隐相反。例如，显性语法教学就是有人向你解释语法规则。

sentences.en: Right. So, adults can't realistically achieve full immersion in a language like children do.
sentences.zh: 对的。所以，成年人在现实中无法像儿童那样实现语言的完全沉浸。

sentences.en: Immersion means being completely surrounded by something.
sentences.zh: 沉浸意味着完全被某事物包围。

sentences.en: OK. So, a mixture of the implicit teaching of the apps and some explicit teaching – for example, learning grammar rules – is useful.
sentences.zh: 好的。因此，将应用的内隐教学与一些显性教学（例如学习语法规则）结合起来是有用的。

sentences.en: But Neil, there's limited research about just how effective these apps can be at teaching you a language.
sentences.zh: 但 Neil，关于这些应用在教你语言方面到底有多大效果，目前的研究还很有限。

sentences.en: Indeed, Liz Wonnacott has seen one study she thinks could be interesting though, which compares two groups of Spanish speakers learning English – one using an app and one attending classes – for a similar amount of time.
sentences.zh: 确实，Liz Wonnacott 看到过一项她认为可能会很有趣的研究，该研究对比了两组学习英语的西班牙语使用者——一组使用应用，一组上课——时间差不多。

sentences.en: She explains more to BBC Radio 4 programme Sliced Bread.
sentences.zh: 她向 BBC Radio 4 的节目 Sliced Bread 解释了更多细节。

sentences.en: The key finding was that in some of the tests, written grammar tests, the Duolingo learners actually improved a bit more, while actually in a test where they were looking at listening the classroom learners appeared to improve more.
sentences.zh: 关键发现是，在其中一些测试（书面语法测试）中，使用 Duolingo 的学习者实际上进步更多一点，而在考察听力的测试中，课堂学习者的进步似乎更大。

sentences.en: So, it's really promising, but of course it's one particular language, in one particular app, against one particular school.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的很让人充满希望，但当然，这是针对一种特定语言、一款特定应用、对比一所特定学校得出的结果。

sentences.en: Liz says the key finding from the research is that the app users improved more on written tests, but the classroom learners improved more on listening tests.
sentences.zh: Liz 表示，研究的关键发现是应用用户的书面测试成绩进步更多，但课堂学习者的听力测试成绩进步更多。

sentences.en: A key finding is the most important conclusion of a piece of research.
sentences.zh: 关键发现是一项研究最重要的结论。

sentences.en: Liz says the study is promising, which means it shows signs of being positive.
sentences.zh: Liz 表示这项研究很有前景，这意味着它表现出积极的迹象。

sentences.en: Yes. However, Liz points out the limits of the study.
sentences.zh: 是的。然而，Liz 指出了该研究的局限性。

sentences.en: It's only looking at one particular language, one particular app and one particular language school.
sentences.zh: 它只着眼于一种特定语言、一款特定应用和一个特定的语言学校。

sentences.en: The repetition of one particular here means specific or individual, and Liz would like to see research on more apps, more types of teaching and also more different languages.
sentences.zh: 这里重复出现的“特定”（one particular）意思是具体的或个别的，Liz 希望看到针对更多应用、更多教学类型以及更多不同语言的研究。

sentences.en: Apps can help us learn some parts of a language, but in this study they weren't as successful at improving listening skills, and so Liz concludes that combining learning in apps with some other ways of studying is the best way to try to improve your language skills.
sentences.zh: 应用可以帮助我们学习语言的一部分，但在这次研究中，它们在提高听力技能方面并不那么成功，因此 Liz 总结认为，将应用学习与一些其他学习方式结合起来，是尝试提高你语言技能的最佳方法。

sentences.en: Probably moving forwards, some combination of human teaching and these platforms to give us that repetition is probably going to be the right direction.
sentences.zh: 可能往前发展的话，将人类教学与这些平台结合起来为我们提供这种重复，可能将是正确的方向。

sentences.en: As teachers, we'd also suggest doing things that help you improve different skills – speaking, listening, reading and writing.
sentences.zh: 作为老师，我们也会建议做一些能帮你在不同技能上都有所提升的事情——说、听、读和写。

sentences.en: So, listening to podcasts or trying to practise speaking with a language exchange partner could be things to combine with learning in apps.
sentences.zh: 所以，听播客或尝试与语言交换伙伴练习口语，都可以与应用中的学习结合起来。

sentences.en: Find what works for you. I think it's time to find out the answer to the quiz question, Neil.
sentences.zh: 找到适合你的方法。我想是时候揭晓问答题的答案了，Neil。

sentences.en: I asked you which language you can't learn on Duolingo... and you were right.
sentences.zh: 我问你哪种语言不能在 Duolingo 上学……你答对了。

sentences.en: It's c) Elvish, but you can learn Latin and Klingon, the fictional language from the TV series Star Trek, on Duolingo.
sentences.zh: 是 c) 精灵语，但你可以在 Duolingo 上学习拉丁语和克林贡语（电视剧《星际迷航》中的虚构语言）。

sentences.en: And if you did want to improve your Elvish, we did find an app specifically for that.
sentences.zh: 如果你确实想提高你的精灵语，我们确实找到了专门为此设计的应用。

sentences.en: Right. Let's recap the vocabulary we learned in this episode.
sentences.zh: 好的。让我们回顾一下我们在本期节目中学到的词汇。

sentences.en: Implicit means suggested but not communicated directly.
sentences.zh: 内隐（Implicit）意为被暗示但未被直接传达。

sentences.en: Explicit is the opposite of implicit. It means something is communicated directly.
sentences.zh: 显性（Explicit）与内隐相反。意为某事被直接传达。

sentences.en: Immersion is the state of being fully surrounded by something.
sentences.zh: 沉浸（Immersion）是完全被某事物包围的状态。

sentences.en: The key finding of a research study is the most important conclusion of the research.
sentences.zh: 研究的关键发现（The key finding）是一项研究中最重要的结论。

sentences.en: And the phrase one particular means specific or individual.
sentences.zh: 短语“特定”（one particular）意为具体的或个别的。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up. Test what you've learned with the worksheet on our website.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，我们的六分钟时间到了。用我们网站上的练习册测试一下你学到的内容吧。

sentences.en: And if you're interested to hear the full episode of Sliced Bread about language-learning apps and the science behind them, there's a link in the notes below this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你有兴趣收听 Sliced Bread 关于语言学习应用及其背后科学的完整节目，本期节目下方的说明里有一个链接。

sentences.en: Try listening on 0.5 speed or in short sections if you find it too difficult to keep up.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得跟上进度太难，可以尝试以 0.5 倍速或分小节收听。

sentences.en: Bye for now! Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 先到这里！再见！
